en.headline: Mark Six draw pauses after machine fault; backup used, jackpot unclaimed
en.dek: Saturday night’s Draw 99 was interrupted when no ball dropped for the first number; the Hong Kong Jockey Club switched to a reserve drum and balls under independent monitoring.
body: A rare fault halted the Mark Six draw on Saturday night before the first number could be drawn, forcing the Hong Kong Jockey Club to switch to a backup machine and a fresh set of numbered balls.

Draw 99 was scheduled for 9.30pm. On the live broadcast the 49 balls continued circulating but none entered the central chute, so the rising mechanism came up empty. Presenter Stephanie Lee announced the switch to a reserve drum, with two independent guests monitoring the process for fairness.

Staff loaded the spare balls into the backup machine in ascending order. After the guests checked the balls and chute, the draw resumed. The interruption lasted about four to five minutes. The final numbers were 9, 18, 24, 33, 40 and 47 with special number 11. The first-division jackpot of about HK$8 million went unclaimed.

The Jockey Club said both machines had been tested before the draw according to standard procedures and that the entire process followed established contingency rules. Total betting before the draw stood at HK$42.59 million.

zh.headline: 六合彩攪珠機故障 改用後備機及號碼球 800萬頭獎無人中
zh.dek: 周六晚第99期六合彩攪珠時原機未能攪出第一個號碼，馬會即時改用同型號後備攪珠機及備用號碼球，在監場嘉賓監察下完成，頭獎無人中。
body: 周六晚上的六合彩攪珠發生罕見故障，原攪珠機未能攪出第一個號碼，香港賽馬會即時改用後備攪珠機及另一套號碼球完成攪珠。
第99期原定晚上9時30分攪珠。直播顯示49個號碼球持續旋轉，但沒有球掉入中央管道，中間裝置升起時仍是空的。主持人即時宣布改用後備機，兩位獨立嘉賓全程監察以確保公正。
工作人員將備用號碼球按由小至大順序放入後備機，嘉賓檢查後重新開始，過程約四至五分鐘。最終攪出號碼為9、18、24、33、40、47，特別號碼11。約800萬元頭獎無人中。
馬會表示，兩部攪珠機在攪珠前均已按程序測試正常，整個過程嚴格按照既定應變機制進行。攪珠前投注總額約4,259萬元。
